rules.quote: edit the `.svg` by hand
rules.rule: When a figure in literature/explainers/ needs changing, edit its .svg file by hand rather than through a generator script.

rules.quote: re-render it (headless Chrome screenshot into an `` wrapper page) to check the result before claiming it is right
rules.rule: After editing a figure SVG, re-render it (headless Chrome screenshot into an wrapper page) and check the result before claiming the change is correct.

rules.quote: Do not propose reintroducing a build step.
rules.rule: Do not propose reintroducing a build step or generator script for the figures.

rules.quote: read the region of the file being changed first
rules.rule: Before editing a figure SVG, read the region of the file being changed first.

rules.quote: Run when GPU free: `python exp/exp_linkbudget_snr.py --task loc --data_dir data/rt_munich_64ant_100000ue_los15`
rules.rule: When the GPU is free, run `python exp/exp_linkbudget_snr.py --task loc --data_dir data/rt_munich_64ant_100000ue_los15` to compare uniform, link-budget, and cross SNR evaluations.

rules.quote: Run after GPU free: `python mu_mimo_eval.py --ckpt checkpoint/recon_best_100k.pt --code_bits none,4,2`
rules.rule: After the GPU is free, run `python mu_mimo_eval.py --ckpt checkpoint/recon_best_100k.pt --code_bits none,4,2` to evaluate multi-user MU-MIMO performance.

rules.quote: add `--tx_power_dbm` for physical
rules.rule: When comparing the physical link-budget SNR anchor in the compare script, add the `--tx_power_dbm` flag.

rules.quote: ACKNOWLEDGE as Limitations/future work (not addressed):
rules.rule: Acknowledge the unaddressed realism gaps (Doppler/channel aging, channel-estimation error, hardware impairments, mutual coupling, single-pol, inter-cell interference, moving scatterers) as limitations or future work, not as modeled effects.

rules.quote: Any new RT set (esp. high indoor fraction) needs this filter
rules.rule: When generating a new RT dataset (especially one with a high indoor fraction), apply the zero-norm UE filter (min_norm_frac=1e-3 via build_multitask_feeds) before training.

rules.quote: check `np.linalg.norm(H.reshape(M,-1),axis=1).min()` after generation
rules.rule: After generating a new RT dataset, check the minimum per-channel Frobenius norm via np.linalg.norm(H.reshape(M,-1),axis=1).min() to detect zero-norm channels.

rules.quote:
**always record to memory when a new experiment
is run and a conclusion is drawn**
rules.rule: Always record to memory when a new experiment is run and a conclusion is drawn, without waiting to be asked each time.

rules.quote:
after any experiment that lands a result/conclusion, update the relevant project
memory
rules.rule: After any experiment that produces a result or conclusion, update the relevant project memory with it.

rules.quote: with the numbers + the conclusion + the artifact path (results/... + the exp script)
rules.rule: When recording an experiment in memory, include the numbers, the conclusion, and the artifact path (results files and the experiment script).

rules.quote:
and add/refresh the
MEMORY.md index line
rules.rule: When recording an experiment in memory, add or refresh the corresponding MEMORY.md index line.

rules.quote: Proactively, not only on request.
rules.rule: Record experiment results to memory proactively, not only when the user requests it.

rules.quote:
Still verify file:line claims before relying
on point-in-time notes.
rules.rule: Verify file:line claims before relying on point-in-time notes recorded in memory.

rules.quote: adopt this as the must-run baseline
rules.rule: Adopt the FLnet staged training recipe (3-step: AE alone, freeze encoder and train loc head, then low-LR joint fine-tune) as a must-run baseline in experiments.

rules.quote: test staging FIRST, reach for PCGrad/ForkMerge only on residual gap.
rules.rule: When addressing joint-training negative transfer, test staged training first and use PCGrad or ForkMerge only if a residual gap remains.

rules.quote: acknowledge in [[beamforming-eval-deliverable]]
rules.rule: Acknowledge in the beamforming evaluation deliverable that the MSE-trained decoder limits sum-rate, since lower NMSE does not imply higher MU-MIMO sum-rate.

rules.quote: re-run the external-prior recon axis at LOW bit budget (code_bits 64/128)
rules.rule: Re-run the external-prior reconstruction experiment at a low bit budget (code_bits 64 or 128) to test whether position helps reconstruction.

rules.quote: SOFTEN finding #3 accordingly
rules.rule: Soften finding #3 (that position does not help reconstruction) to reflect the conflicting FLnet Table VIII evidence.

rules.quote: cite TWC for any GPS-aided claim
rules.rule: Cite the FLnet TWC 2024 paper, not the ICC-2023 precursor, for any GPS-aided localization claim.

rules.quote: do NOT attribute it there
rules.rule: Do not attribute the complexity caveat to the abstract of arXiv 2603.14317.

rules.quote: do NOT attribute the caveat to it
rules.rule: Do not attribute the gain-insufficient caveat to arXiv 2506.21796, which is a positive interoperability result.

rules.quote: cite 38.843 §8 directly
rules.rule: Cite TR 38.843 §8 directly for the RAN1 no-consensus conclusion on AI/ML CSI compression.

rules.quote: Cite it as evidence two-sided ML feedback is practically feasible.
rules.rule: Cite arXiv 2506.21796 as evidence that two-sided ML CSI feedback is practically feasible.

rules.quote: trace the exact sentence here before quoting
rules.rule: Trace the exact sentence in arXiv 2206.15132 before quoting it for the complexity caveat.

rules.quote: read before quoting
rules.rule: Read the source of the unverified researchgate 366043969 / 2603.14317 caveat before quoting it.

rules.quote: cite as roadmap motivation AND honest limitation
rules.rule: Cite the Rel-19 gain-insufficient and inter-vendor caveat as both roadmap motivation and an honest limitation.

rules.quote: NOT quantitative comparisons to our outdoor MU-MIMO RT
rules.rule: Do not treat indoor WiFi fingerprinting benchmark numbers as quantitative comparisons to our outdoor MU-MIMO RT results; use them only as SOTA-scale context.

rules.quote: re-balance TOWARD loc (fixed-λ loc-weight sweep / CAGrad / ForkMerge), NOT staging.
rules.rule: To improve joint localization, rebalance training toward localization (fixed-λ loc-weight sweep, CAGrad, or ForkMerge) rather than using staged training.

rules.quote: fix: orient panel azimuth + ~10° downtilt, sample illuminated sector
rules.rule: In the RT data-generation config, orient the panel azimuth with about 10° downtilt and sample only the illuminated sector instead of a 360° box.

rules.quote: set ≈0.5 + pattern
rules.rule: Set the Sionna scattering coefficient to about 0.5 and supply a scattering pattern so the diffuse flag is active.

rules.quote: Deliberate UPGRADES to keep
rules.rule: Keep the deliberate configuration upgrades: 64-antenna 8×8 UPA, 27 m macro BS, Sionna RT with diffuse scattering, and indoor UEs.

rules.quote: cite directly, no PDF
rules.rule: Cite the classical CS baselines (LASSO, TVAL3, BM3D-AMP, Cressie variogram) directly from their publications without a local PDF.

rules.quote: I do NOT re-run `convert_channel_angle_delay`
rules.rule: Do not re-run convert_channel_angle_delay on the RT-generated CSI, because it is already in the delay domain; only the angular DFT should be applied.

rules.quote: L_rec = NMSE (O(1)), NOT raw MSE
rules.rule: Use NMSE as the reconstruction loss L_rec in multitask training, not raw MSE.

rules.quote: phase ref = strongest element, NOT [0,0]
rules.rule: When removing the global phase in normalize_csi, use the strongest CSI element as the phase reference, not element [0,0].

rules.quote: standardized on TRAIN split only
rules.rule: Standardize the log-Frobenius magnitude using statistics from the training split only, to avoid leakage.

rules.quote: Scene bounds via `scene.mi_scene.bbox()`
rules.rule: Obtain scene bounds via scene.mi_scene.bbox(), not via scene.center or scene.size attributes.

rules.quote: Indoor UEs ARE included.
rules.rule: Include indoor UEs in the generated dataset.

rules.quote: Zero-power UEs (deeply shielded, unlocalizable) still dropped.
rules.rule: Drop UEs with zero received power from the dataset.

rules.quote: `normalize_cfr=False` → keeps absolute path loss
rules.rule: Set normalize_cfr=False when generating RT data so absolute path loss is kept as a localization distance cue.

rules.quote: Per-sample Frobenius norm deferred to load time.
rules.rule: Apply the per-sample Frobenius norm at data load time, not during RT generation.

rules.quote: keep one per PRB
rules.rule: Keep one subcarrier per PRB when subsampling the generated subcarriers.

rules.quote: batch_size=25 (Dr.Jit 2^32 limit)
rules.rule: Use batch_size=25 for RT generation to stay under the Dr.Jit 2^32 limit.

rules.quote: test pure-NLOS first; LOS/NLOS comparison (re-aim azimuth) deferred.
rules.rule: Test the pure-NLOS configuration first and defer the LOS/NLOS comparison that requires re-aiming the azimuth.

rules.quote: loc_source='decoder' only for csinet.
rules.rule: Use loc_source='decoder' only with the csinet backbone, not with the transformer backbone.

rules.quote: Don't pursue single-snapshot self-aiding further.
rules.rule: Do not pursue single-snapshot self-aiding (a self-derived prior from one codeword) any further.

rules.quote: DO NOT overclaim "position doesn't help recon" as universal
rules.rule: Do not state that position does not help reconstruction as a universal claim; qualify it to the operating point (high feedback rate, dense-scattering scene).

rules.quote: Match the training budget for any comparison.
rules.rule: When comparing training runs, match their training budget (batch size and epochs) so they have the same number of gradient updates.

rules.quote:
Don't pick bs512 "for speed" without
  LR scaling.
rules.rule: Do not reduce the batch size to 512 for speed unless the learning rate is scaled accordingly.

rules.quote: **`nll_decoupled`** is the recommended variant
rules.rule: Prefer the nll_decoupled variant for the --loc_loss option.

rules.quote: detached-σ-must-stay-outside-the-task-weighting rule
rules.rule: Keep the detached sigma NLL term outside the task uncertainty weighting (add it as a separate loss term), never folded into the localization loss before task weighting.

rules.quote: Run on GPU.
rules.rule: Run the sigma calibration diagnostic (exp/diag_sigma_calibration.py) on GPU.

rules.quote: ~0.02 if revisited
rules.rule: If the self_aided gate is revisited, set gate_scale to about 0.02 instead of 0.15.

rules.quote: report % of perfect / relative only
rules.rule: When reporting sum-rate results from the unit-normalized channel setup, report only percent-of-perfect or relative values, not absolute bits/s/Hz.

rules.quote: CSI-error SENSITIVITY, not system capacity
rules.rule: Frame sum-rate results as a measure of CSI-error sensitivity, not as system capacity.

rules.quote: Headline numbers to report:
rules.rule: When reporting localization and reconstruction results, use the geographic-split numbers as headline figures: reconstruction/beamforming is leakage-robust, and honest localization generalization is about 20 m MAE / 12.5 m p50 at 100k.

rules.quote: flag explicitly
rules.rule: Explicitly flag that the 4.7 m and 5.3 m localization figures from the random split are upper bounds.

rules.quote: list explicitly
rules.rule: Explicitly list the static-snapshot scope limits (no inter-cell interference, pilot contamination, hardware impairments, or channel aging) when reporting results.

rules.quote: Honest claim: DL's win is overwhelmingly better CSI-subspace compression, small denoising bonus only
rules.rule: When describing the denoising result, claim that DL's win is overwhelmingly better CSI-subspace compression, with only a small denoising bonus versus CS at low SNR.

rules.quote: DO NOT IMPLEMENT, cite instead
rules.rule: Do not implement the TR 38.901 §8.4 map-based hybrid channel model; cite it instead.

rules.quote: cite §8/Table 8.4-1 to legitimize the RT EM-interaction principles Sionna uses
rules.rule: Cite TR 38.901 §8 and Table 8.4-1 to justify the ray-tracing EM-interaction principles that Sionna uses.

rules.quote: frame pure-deterministic Sionna RT as a CLEANER instance of the 3GPP map-based methodology
rules.rule: Frame the pure-deterministic Sionna ray-tracing as a cleaner instance of the 3GPP map-based methodology, presenting the omitted stochastic overlay as a principled choice rather than a gap.

rules.quote: OPTIONAL only if a committee demands a diffuse-mismatch test
rules.rule: Use an eval-time-only stochastic-cluster perturbation as a robustness probe only if a committee demands a diffuse-mismatch test.

rules.quote: never in training
rules.rule: Never use stochastic-cluster perturbation during training.

rules.quote:
Do NOT assume 38.857's
bandwidth scaling
rules.rule: Do not assume the 38.857 bandwidth-scaling expectation (100 MHz ≈ 9 m vs 5 MHz ≈ 40 m at 90%) holds for the fingerprinting-based localization method; instead, measure the bandwidth dependence experimentally.

rules.quote: **OPEN EXPERIMENT — run the bandwidth sweep DOWNWARD to 20 MHz**
rules.rule: Run the bandwidth sweep downward to 20 MHz (in addition to the existing upward sweep 100→200→400 MHz) to measure localization performance at lower bandwidths.

rules.quote: Cite UMi-SC geometry + note the rooftop/UMa BS height.
rules.rule: When describing the Munich scenario's geometry, cite the UMi-SC geometry and note the rooftop/UMa base-station height as a deviation.

rules.quote: Separate the two requirements: **duplexing is hard**
rules.rule: When arguing for the FDD choice, treat duplexing as a hard requirement distinct from carrier/bandwidth, which is a soft requirement.

rules.quote: state it
rules.rule: State the deviation of the Munich RT indoor/outdoor UE drop (~58% indoor) from the 100%-outdoor idealization explicitly in the thesis.

rules.quote: note it
rules.rule: Note in the thesis that the Sionna max_depth of 10 exceeds the 3GPP-recommended reflection/penetration orders.

rules.quote:
frame as "a map-based deterministic instantiation of TR 38.901
clause 8"
rules.rule: Frame the Sionna ray-tracing methodology in the thesis as a map-based deterministic instantiation of TR 38.901 clause 8, not as a departure from 3GPP.
Cite TR 38.857 (3.5 GHz) as the carrier-frequency source rather than TR 38.855 (2/4 GHz).

rules.quote:
cite §7.9 to SCOPE OUT the device-free
branch, not as a model we use
rules.rule: Cite TR 38.901 §7.9 only to scope out the device-free ISAC branch, not as a channel model used by the project.

rules.quote: CsiNet+ LOCKED as final backbone
rules.rule: Use CsiNet+ as the final backbone for the CSI feedback model rather than the Swin backbone.

rules.quote: fused F.scaled_dot_product_attention
rules.rule: When reviving the Swin backbone, use fused F.scaled_dot_product_attention instead of eager manual windowed attention.

rules.quote: torch.compile
rules.rule: When reviving the Swin backbone, compile the model with torch.compile for speed.

rules.quote: stride-2 stem
rules.rule: When reviving the Swin backbone, use a stride-2 stem so training starts at 32x32 with 4x fewer tokens.

rules.quote: lr 3e-4 + warmup for convergence
rules.rule: When reviving the Swin backbone, train with learning rate 3e-4 and a warmup schedule.

rules.quote: cite as **"CsiNet+-based"** not verbatim CsiNet+
rules.rule: When citing the thesis backbone, describe it as "CsiNet+-based", not as verbatim CsiNet+.

rules.quote: DO IT THE CHEAP WAY: trajectory sampling in our existing Sionna RT generator
rules.rule: When generating sequential or trajectory CSI data for temporal experiments, use trajectory sampling in the existing Sionna RT generator, not ns-3.

rules.quote: Cite as deployment/Digital-Network-Twin framing, DON'T build.
rules.rule: Do not build an ns-3 + 5G-LENA + ns3-rt integration.

rules.quote: Only worth it if committee wants system-level KPIs (throughput/latency/handover)
rules.rule: Pursue an ns-3 / 5G-LENA integration only if the committee wants system-level KPIs such as throughput, latency, or handover.

rules.quote: DO IT WITHOUT ns-3
rules.rule: For end-to-end application-KPI evaluation, do not use ns-3; use a trace-driven, semi-analytic evaluation instead.

rules.quote: Decision recorded so it isn't re-litigated.
rules.rule: Do not re-open the decision against adopting ns-3 / 5G-LENA / ns3-rt.

rules.quote: Cite ns-3/5G-LENA/ns3-rt as the deployment/digital-twin future path
rules.rule: Cite ns-3, 5G-LENA, and ns3-rt as the deployment/digital-twin future path, not as built work.

rules.quote: report as a diminishing-returns scaling curve
rules.rule: Report the multi-gNB results as a diminishing-returns scaling curve: the 1→2 gNB step is the large win and the 3rd gNB is a smaller tail improvement.

rules.quote: keep as METADATA not model input
rules.rule: Store the sector_id label as metadata only; do not use it as a model input, because it would leak localization information.

rules.quote:
WRITE the explanation directly into that doc using LaTeX math ($…$ inline,
$$…$$ display) — do NOT deliver it only as a terminal reply.
rules.rule: When explaining code or concepts from thesis_code_walkthrough_QA.md, write the explanation directly into that doc using LaTeX math ($…$ inline, $$…$$ display), not only as a terminal reply.

rules.quote:
Edit the doc (add a subsection under the relevant Topic) as the primary
deliverable
rules.rule: For "explain topic X" or "walk through this code" requests tied to the walkthrough, edit the doc by adding a subsection under the relevant Topic as the primary deliverable.

rules.quote: keep the terminal reply short (a pointer + offer next step)
rules.rule: Keep the terminal reply short, limited to a pointer to the doc and an offer of a next step.

rules.quote:
Line-by-line code
walkthroughs go in the doc too.
rules.rule: Put line-by-line code walkthroughs in the doc as well.

rules.quote:
Integrate answers/corrections into the existing prose as if always
written that way.
rules.rule: Integrate answers and corrections into the existing prose of the doc as if it had always been written that way.

rules.quote: Never restate the question in the doc
rules.rule: Never restate the question in the doc.

rules.quote:
never add meta-notes about the edit
("Notation warning", "As requested", "renamed X to Y")
rules.rule: Never add meta-notes about the edit to the doc, such as "Notation warning", "As requested", or "renamed X to Y".

rules.quote: never leave changelog markers
rules.rule: Never leave changelog markers in the doc.

rules.quote:
integrate
rather than accrete: merge into the existing explanation instead of appending a second,
overlapping one.
rules.rule: Merge new material into the existing explanation rather than appending a second, overlapping one.

rules.quote:
**Check the doc before writing** — if the answer is already there, say so in
chat and leave the doc unchanged, or sharpen the existing passage
rules.rule: Before writing, check the doc: if the answer is already there, say so in chat and leave the doc unchanged, or sharpen the existing passage.

rules.quote:
add a new paragraph only
when the information is genuinely new.
rules.rule: Add a new paragraph to the doc only when the information is genuinely new.

rules.quote: Only annotate if explicitly asked.
rules.rule: Only add annotations to the doc if explicitly asked.

rules.quote: Run from the repo root: `python tools/render_walkthrough.py`
rules.rule: Run the walkthrough render script (`python tools/render_walkthrough.py`) from the repository root.

rules.quote: republish the same file path to keep the URL
rules.rule: When republishing the walkthrough Artifact, use the same file path so the existing URL is kept.

rules.quote: maths is converted to **MathML at build time**, NOT with MathJax
rules.rule: Convert maths to MathML at build time in the walkthrough HTML render; do not use MathJax.

rules.quote: do not regress them
rules.rule: Do not regress the gotchas baked into the walkthrough render script.

rules.quote: fenced code blocks and inline `code` spans must be stashed before any `$` rule
rules.rule: Stash fenced code blocks before applying any `$` math rule in the walkthrough render script.

rules.quote: fenced code blocks and inline `code` spans must be stashed before any `$` rule
rules.rule: Stash inline `code` spans before applying any `$` math rule in the walkthrough render script.

rules.quote: the inline pattern must allow a newline but not a blank line
rules.rule: The inline math pattern in the walkthrough render script must allow a newline within the expression but not a blank line.

rules.quote: the image regex must tolerate them
rules.rule: The image regex in the walkthrough render script must tolerate balanced brackets in image alt text.
